dedupe_keys.name: european soil data centre esdac jrc european soil database and soil threat datasets

description: The European Soil Data Centre is the JRC's data hub for soil in Europe and part of the EU Soil Observatory. It distributes the European Soil Database and a long list of thematic soil datasets and maps. Coverage: Europe, with parts extending to Eurasia and some global layers; the European Soil Database v2.0 (2004) is described as the only harmonised soil database for Europe and combines the Soil Geographical Database of Eurasia (SGDBE, polygons with essential soil attributes), the Pedotransfer Rules Database (PTRDB) and the Soil Profile Analytical Database, with a derived 1 km raster library; the thematic pages cover soil erosion by water and wind (European baseline, 2050 projections, global erosion and rainfall erosivity R-factor), soil organic carbon, compaction, salinisation, soil biodiversity, landslides, soil sealing and contamination. Format and access: vector data with attribute tables in the GISCO Lambert azimuthal projection, 1 km rasters and documentation; the European Soil Database is free after registration through an online request form, after which download instructions are sent. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): ESDAC data licence agreement (ESDB v2.0: free of charge, no passing to third parties, no commercial use); terms set per dataset. Caveats: each dataset has its own request form and page, and only the European Soil Database page was read in full; the core database dates from 2004. Simulation uses: soil erodibility, compaction and landslide layers for hazard exposure of roads, rail, pipelines and embankments, and for climate adaptation studies of land-based infrastructure. Related records: EGMS ground motion (data-copernicus-european-ground-motion-service) and the LUCAS survey (data-eurostat-lucas-land-use-cover-survey) that feeds ESDAC's topsoil data.
